svg.title: Reviewed marker states become phenotypes through ordered Boolean masks
svg.desc: A schematic reviewed finite upper-positive gate for marker M1 maps finite x at least t1 to positive, lower x to negative, and missing or nonfinite values to unknown. The four-cell state matrix adds separately reviewed M2 and M3. Rule A requires M1 positive and M2 negative, ignoring M3. Rule B requires M1 positive and ignores M2 and M3. In precedence order, each rule's match vector is intersected with the still-unassigned vector. A receives i1, B receives i2 while recording overlap with i1, and i3 and i4 receive the residual phenotype. Unknown M3 does not block i1 because it is unused; unknown required M1 prevents i4 from matching. The data and phenotype names are illustrative, not inferred biological results.
